description: Is it altcoin season? Daily Altcoin-Season indicator (v7 Native-Filter methodology). Returns BTC-, alt- and stablecoin dominance, the 4 Layer-1 signals (alt_dominance, total_market_cap, btc_dominance, stable_dominance — weekly smoothed-Heikin-Ashi directions; weights in methodology.layer1), overall color (red/yellow/green) and Layer 2: altcoin_season_pct (share of top-50 alts beating BTC over 90 days) with altcoin_season_pct_basis (beating / eligible / expected — coins without a 90-day return drop out of the denominator) and altcoin_season_pct_provenance (grade full/partial/thin; fields="full" names the missing coins), plus the top-30 CoinGecko snapshot. [Free tier]

fields.description: Omit for the default response, which carries `provenance` in short form (grade full/partial/thin, sources_used, sources_expected). 'full' adds the long form: sources_missing (named), sources (licence attribution names), grade_reason, as_of — plus per-part provenance where the composite has parts. A `thin` grade (under half the expected inputs) is never a basis for a verdict or a ranking.

name: arena_get_altcoin_season
title: Get Altcoin Season Snapshot
